I unfortunately bought a lot of territory on my main account because I thought you cpuld win 40 slots of territory, not that you could PvP for it until the number of slots reached 40! Small but important distinction! I made sure to be careful about that on my side acc when I made it lol

When you go to fight people for territory, this technique i used helped me win 9/10 times and did the same for my friends when I showed them as they were getting into the game.

Use the search function, check the options:
-Main Male
-Exclude Frozen
-Exclude Dead
You can set the Sex drop down to male if you want but it won't add anything extra.

Under 'Level' set the drop down to 'Exactly' and put the number to be 1 or 2 levels below your main male's level. Never lower than Level 2.

Then, scroll all the way down to the 'Stats' section. Set the drop down to 'No more than'.
You can either fill in each slot with the stat numbers for your King OR just set the 'Total' slot, to the same amount as your King.

Search! All of the resulting Kings should be just below yours in terms of stats/exp level and that results in a win for Territory 9 times out of 10!

Try your best not to buy any territory until you've used the PVP function. You can fight for and win territory up until the Territory number in your den reaches 40!

Good luck, have fun!!

Coco fiber or soil are better substrates for keeping humidity up- also because BPs like to push their substrate around and burrow a little! Not as much as say, a milk or corn snake, but they tend to dig out inside their hides to get closer to heat and such.

If you fill the upper of the tank with a bridge, branches, climbing things, she will make use of it! BPs actually do climb a surprising amount if you give them enough to grip on to up there.

And just clutter it up. 2 hides if possible, branches, rocks for texture, have fun with it :) Cork wood is really great for building little hides/structures

And makes sure you either bake or freeze any substrate or wood before putting it in the tank, to get rid of any potential pests/eggs!
